column4: the store reads a blob through StorageStore.open(file, readOptions) with READ_ONLY options, whose AUTO backend resolves to MAPPED_FILE: FileChannel READ, size at open, READ_ONLY mappings of <= 1 GiB segments, copy into the caller's array. M3PmemSdk.open refuses length <= 0 (empty extents are part of the donor contract), checks span <= size but not size == length (the exact-length refusal), its FILE backend is positional I/O, not a mapping, and binding it adds the module edge org.m3jdk.file -> org.m3jdk.optane. M3NioFile refuses symbolic links (a behaviour change). The donor's own FOSS decision for the mapped backend is DIRECT_IMPORT of FileChannel / MappedByteBuffer
column6: the READ_BACKEND SUBST rows restate the AUTO path on java.nio (one READ_ONLY mapping of [0, length), the exact-length check first, a zero-length blob maps nothing); the facade family is HELD (H1); differential.sh proves the dumps byte-identical
